sentences.text:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anil Kshetarpal
Present:

Mr. R.K.Bajaj, Advocate, for the petitioners
 Mr. Hittan Nehra, Addl. A.G.,Punjab
Anil Kshetarpal, J(Oral)
Crm-30880-2019 Prayer in the application is for restoration of the petition.
For reasons mentioned in the application, which is supported by an affidavit, the application is allowed and the petition is retorted to its original number.

MAIN Learned counsels for the parties do not dispute that the prosecution of distributor/retailer under Section 16(1)(a)(i) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 cannot be allowed to continue, if the food article was packed in sealed jars and there are no allegations of tampering.

Reference in this regard can be made to the judgments passed by this Court in the cases of Vijay Kumar vs. State of Punjab, 2012 (27) R.C.R.(criminal) 196, Hemant Grover vs. State of Haryana and others, 2014 (12) r.c.r.(cRIMINAL) 1999, M/s Guru Nanak Pesticides, Nabha and others vs. State of Punjab, 2010(1) R.C.R.(Criminal) 30 and M/s Vimal & Co., Grain Market, Mullanpur vs. State of Punjab, 2002(2) R.C.R.(Criminal) 56.
